_comment: Approval-packet manifest for the septic case study. Everything here is
specific to the approval request rather than to the site; the case study
text itself is read from src/content/projects/septic-system-design-support.md
so the two cannot drift.
The images are deliberately NOT in this repository (SPEC 3.2 gates drawing
images at the repository until written approval exists). They live in Vin's
Google Drive under the SSE folder, account catavp@farmingdale.edu:
plan-view.png  <- 'Screenshot 2026-09-01 120154.png', Drive id 1EzmMIoDo4-kvmRqqQ4JR0KSVu828_EhJ
calc-sheet.png <- 'Screenshot 2026-09-01 133309.png', Drive id 1Sqi40tAMDu4ivV5GUF7LB6c5OzA_ewmU
Download both, rename to the filenames below, run strip-metadata, then pass
the folder as --images-dir.
CHECKLIST CORRECTION, 11 September 2026. The packet sent on 3 September
carried a row reading ["Site elevations", "Removed from image"]. That was
false. The site plan still shows rim and invert elevations in the structure
callouts, a top-of-wall and bottom-of-wall pair, a spot elevation on the
fence line, and several labelled contour lines. Only the dwelling's finished
floor and basement floor elevations had been cropped, which is what image 1's
'removed' list below correctly says. The global checklist and the per-image
list contradicted each other and the checklist was the one written as a
certification. The row is deleted rather than reworded, and must not be
restored for this image until the elevations are actually gone at the CAD
source. See docs/open-items.md and docs/approvals/septic-images-addendum.md.
The checklist is a CERTIFICATION to a supervisor, not boilerplate. Re-verify
every row against every image, corner to corner, before each send. Never
carry a row forward on the strength of a previous packet.
asking: For my CON162 assignment I am building a professional portfolio website. I would like to include one write-up of work I did here this summer, along with two redacted images. Nothing has been published, and nothing will be, until you tell me it is approved.

This document contains the exact text I propose to post, word for word, and the exact images. Please review and tell me whether to publish it as written, publish it with changes you mark, or leave it out entirely.
I have followed the guidance you both gave: general description of scope and my role only, no client information, no site information, and the supervision of a licensed engineer stated plainly.
generalTerms: A residential on-site wastewater (septic) system design from this past summer, including the sizing calculations and the AutoCAD drawing set. I have deliberately not written down which job it is. You will know it from this description.

images.title: partial site plan, plan view
images.caption: Septic (I/A OWTS) system layout, plan view (redacted).
removed: The boundary bearing and distance along the property line
The proposed dwelling's finished floor and basement floor elevations
The title block, firm name, and any seal
All file metadata (author, originating software, original file path)
images.note: What remains is the system layout itself: pipe runs, the leaching pool, the drywell locations, the distribution box, the treatment unit callout, and the standard offset dimensions.

images.title: sizing calculations excerpt
images.caption: Sanitary system sizing calculations: design flow, treatment unit selection, and leaching pool area.
images.note: This is the calculation block from the drawing. It shows the groundwater management zone, the bedroom count and resulting design flow in gallons per day, the required and proposed treatment unit capacity, and the required and provided leaching pool sidewall area. It carries no address, no client name, no permit or application number, no lot number, and no title block or seal. Nothing was cropped out of it, because there was nothing on it to remove. File metadata has been stripped.

checklist: Property address or location beyond "a residential parcel"
Permit, application, or municipal case number
Lot number, boundary bearings, or survey dimensions
Title block, PE seal, or firm logo
Names of any other person or firm
File metadata (author, software, original file path)
Supervision by a licensed PE stated explicitly
replyOptions: Approved as written. I publish exactly what is above, and nothing more.
Approved with changes. Mark up this document, or tell me which sentences or images to change or cut, and I publish the corrected version.
Not approved. I leave this project off the site entirely and it goes no further.
closing: If it is useful, I am happy to send any future write-up through this same format before anything goes up. I would rather check every time than guess wrong once.
Thank you both for the time on this, and for what this internship has already taught me.
